metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a title, a short loaf, one page, and the friar's letter.

yesterday: Barnardo and Fiammetta is on the tables. You are for the desk after the post.
The loaf at dinner was two fingers and more short. She called the answer sound doctrine.
You wrote one page. The questions sit in the margin.
Old Swan Stairs is tomorrow, before you are Egeon at two.
